Maya Chen: Heads up — I'm handing off ops for the Catalyst cohort seats. Need a quick confirm on enablement schedule + feedback loop. I'll be OOO next Tue so want to lock owners now.

Liam Park: Thanks Maya. I pulled current enroll numbers — 12 accounts, 38 seats reserved, 5 pending invites. Marked 2 as renewal-risk (BroadWave, NovaPay) due to legal/contract delays. CSV uploaded to s3://redwood-cs/catalyst/enrollments.csv.

Aria Patel: I can run two enablement sessions (demo + quick setup). Avail Wed 10–11am PT and Fri 2–3pm PT. Which slot should we offer first?

Tomás Rivera: On BroadWave — legal asked for SOC docs. Can CS own the intro to Security team? I can join the customer call if needed.

Maya Chen: Yes pls Tomás — that one is high touch. Liam: paste CSV header here and add a notes column for risk_reason so handoff is clear.

Liam Park: Pasted CSV sample header/snippet:
```csv
account,contact,email,seats,status,risk_reason
BroadWave,Helen Jones,helen@bwave.com,5,pending,"legal:SOC-2"
NovaPay,Ops Team,ops@novapay.com,4,pending,"contract:pricing"
```

Aria Patel: Draft invite email for review:
"Hi {name},
Thanks for joining Catalyst. We'd love to get you into a 45m enablement (demo + setup). Choose a slot: [Wed 10am PT] or [Fri 2pm PT]. Also a 1-question pre-survey: primary integration (UI / API / Embeddings / Other)."
Can we make the pre-survey one required field so we can tailor the demo?

Maya Chen: Good. Keep the pre-survey to 1 q. Also add an opt-in for a deeper POC discussion.

Tomás Rivera: For feedback cadence I recommend: 48-hour pulse after enablement (quick happiness + blockers), then a 14-day usage check-in. Proposal: create #catalyst-advocates Slack channel to consolidate feedback and champion wins.

Liam Park: I'll create the Slack channel and seed invites. Also opened a ticket to automate the 48h pulse via outreach-bot (TKT-5832).

onboard-bot: Scheduled enablement sessions: Wed 2026-04-14 17:00 UTC, Fri 2026-04-16 21:00 UTC — invites sent (12 attendees).

Maya Chen: Perfect. Can someone own the NovaPay pricing follow-up? I'm handing BroadWave to Tomás.

Aria Patel: I'll take NovaPay follow-up after the enablement — will coordinate with Product for trial credits.

Tomás Rivera: Got BroadWave. I'll intro them to Security this afternoon and confirm SOC docs delivery ETA.

Liam Park: Final checklist I'll run before full handoff: invite status, survey link live, slack channel created, session recording enabled, seed demo prompts, handover doc in Confluence. Confluence link: https://redwood-internal.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/CS/pages/123456/Catalyst+Handoff

Maya Chen: Leaving notes in Confluence now and tagging owners. @here quick thumbs if you got your assignment. :thumbsup: :eyes:
